title: Socoteco II plebiscite gets fresh push amid El Niño fears
summary: A business group is calling for the immediate resumption of a plebiscite for the proposed joint venture between South Cotabato II Electric Cooperative (Socoteco II) and Ignite Power amid concerns…

blocks.text: A business group is calling for the immediate resumption of a plebiscite for the proposed joint venture between South Cotabato II Electric Cooperative (Socoteco II) and Ignite Power amid concerns about a worsening power crunch, especially with the looming strong El Niño. The General Santos City Chamber of Commerce and Industry (GSCCCI) said it was “extremely important to have a ‘white knight’” to help the power cooperative address the threat of tight electricity supply.
